title: [Runner] Fix false-positive Win+Shift+C shortcut conflict on Windows 11

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: The validation-only hook now preserves the repository imports, and the actual build confirmed vcpkg integration and the dependency include root. The Runner build still failed on two generated WinRT headers. Both headers exist and the compiler include roots match; their full paths exceed 260 characters, making path length the current unproven cause. A private short-path correction is being prepared without changing the product or literal candidate. Native tests and discovery did not run; no passing result is claimed.

next_action: Resume the saved review stage in the next dashboard update.
